name: Cerberus-AIO
description: Cerberus is a self-hosted website security and quality scanner with local Lighthouse, Nuclei, OWASP ZAP, sqlmap, local users, history, PDF-ready reports, and optional AI analysis. This AIO master launches the isolated child stack. It requires the Docker socket, which grants control of the Docker host; install only the official image and review release notes before updating.

paths.name: AIO configuration
paths.description: Named Docker volume holding generated AIO secrets. Keep this exact named-volume style so child containers can mount it.

paths.name: Docker socket
paths.description: Required to create and update child containers. This grants Docker-host control.

variables.name: Config volume name
variables.description: Must exactly match the named volume mounted at /config.

variables.name: Enable active scans
variables.description: Enables owner-confirmed Nuclei, ZAP, and sqlmap scans. Leave false unless needed.
